lidless.options.title: Lidless
lidless.options.peek.tooltip: Show what is inside the container you are looking at.
lidless.options.require_sneak.tooltip: Only show the peek panel while you hold the sneak key.
lidless.options.compact.tooltip: Group identical items and show totals instead of the exact slot layout.
lidless.options.remember.tooltip: On servers, remember what was inside a container the last time you opened it.
lidless.options.tooltip_preview.tooltip: Show the contents of shulker boxes and your ender chest as a grid in item tooltips.
lidless.options.search_box.tooltip: Add a search box to storage screens. Ctrl+F focuses it. Use @name to search by mod.
lidless.options.sort_buttons.tooltip: Add sort, deposit and take all buttons to storage screens, and a sort button to your inventory.
lidless.options.middle_click_sort.toolti: Middle-click a slot to sort that part of the screen. Not in creative mode, where middle-click copies items.
lidless.options.rows.tooltip: The most rows of items the peek panel shows.
lidless.options.x_position.tooltip: Where the peek panel sits, from the left edge (0%) to the right edge (100%).
lidless.options.y_position.tooltip: Where the peek panel sits, from the top edge (0%) to the bottom edge (100%).
lidless.sort.name: Name
lidless.peek.unknown: Open it once to remember it
